description: This file defines a Orleans grain class 'PersonGrain' that manages person-related state with event sourcing, including methods for registration, marriage, name change, and testing tentative vs. confirmed state versions.

classes.name: PersonGrain
classes.description: A stateful Orleans grain that manages person information with event sourcing, including tentative and confirmed states, and contains internal testing methods.

methods.name: RegisterBirth
methods.description: Registers a person's birth if not previously registered; raises a PersonRegistered event.

methods.name: Marry
methods.description: Handles marriage logic, raising appropriate events and ensuring single spousal relationship.

methods.name: ChangeLastName
methods.description: Raises an event to change the last name; does not confirm immediately.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed version number.

methods.name: GetTentativeVersion
methods.description: Returns the tentative version number based on unconfirmed events.

methods.name: AssertEqual
methods.description: Private utility method for asserting equality in tests.

methods.name: RunTentativeConfirmedStateTest
methods.description: A private method serving as a unit test for the tentative vs. confirmed state logic.
